description:
List the URLs affected by a specific Site Audit issue in the property's latest crawl. Pass issueCode (an issue_code from list_site_audit_issues). Optionally pass indexable=true|false to restrict to one bucket of the indexable / non-indexable split (omit for both). Each row returns the url, value (the per-page offending value — the check's own description for that URL, may be null) and first_seen_crawl (not tracked, always null). Cursor-paginated: pass the returned next_cursor for the next page (limit defaults to 50, max 200). Defaults to the most-recently-finished audit; pass the auditId argument (an audit_id from list_site_audit_projects) to target a specific one. Returns issue_not_found for an unknown issueCode and no_crawl_data when the property has no completed crawl. Pass the property ID (UUID) or URL (sc-domain:...) from list_properties.

Cost: 5 credits per call.

Examples:
```json
// List URLs missing a title tag in the latest site audit crawl.
{"property":"sc-domain:example.com","issueCode":"TITLE_TAG_MISSING","limit":50}
```
name: list_site_audit_issue_pages
title: Pages affected by an issue
